Extracted from the Supporting Information (sc2c05497_si_001.pdf, pages cited as S-numbers). Loaded: the three PET chemical-recycling routes (enzymatic hydrolysis, glycolysis, methanolysis) with TRL and minimum selling price (Table S27), plant life and IRR (Table S20), and site energy and flake inputs per kg of recycled PET (Tables S10, S12, S13). Not loaded: capital costs (Table S28, per plant on a bale-feed basis, no currency year), mechanical and dissolution recycling (no archetype), gasification and pyrolysis (Table S29, per kg recycled polymer via low monomer yields), life-cycle energy and GHG (cradle-to-gate, not site values). All kept in _other-values.csv.

(1) No currency year is printed in the article or SI; 2020 USD is assumed from the 2016-2020 price data. (2) Capacity is given only as 150 t/d of bale feed. (3) 'Refrigeration'/'Refrigerant' is listed in kWh without saying whether it is electricity or cooling duty.
